douyin-mini-game-unity 1.0.0 — initial release

- Provides a comprehensive C# API reference for integrating Unity games with the Douyin (TikTok China) mini-game platform, covering 200+ TT.* SDK methods.
- Includes initialization, login/auth, payments, advertising, device features, file system, network, storage, UI, media, open-platform capabilities, and more.
- Offers C# equivalents for JavaScript `tt.*` APIs, enabling Unity projects to adapt or port for Douyin mini-games.
- Documentation features module breakdowns, side-by-side API mapping tables, best practice guidance, and example code for common workflows (init, login, payment, ads).
- Based on official Douyin mini-game SDK docs (TTSDK >= 6.0.0).
